untraded_death: Died to {killerName} in {zone} and was not traded within {tradeWindowS} s; the nearest of {teammatesAlive} living teammates was {nearestTeammateM} m away.
untraded_death.no_positions: Died to {killerName} in {zone} and was not traded within {tradeWindowS} s while {teammatesAlive} teammates were alive.
shot_while_moving: Fired {movingShots} of {shots} shots with the {weapon} while moving at up to {speedUps} u/s in {zone}; accurate speed is {accurateSpeedUps} u/s.
unused_utility: Died in {zone} after {timeAliveS} s with {grenadesUnused} unused grenades ({grenadeList}).
dry_peek: Died to {killerName} in {zone} {timeToDeathS} s after first contact, with no flash or smoke from the team before the fight.
team_flash: Own flash blinded {teammatesBlinded} teammates in {zone} (longest {longestBlindS} s) and {enemiesBlinded} enemies.
team_flash.self: Own flash blinded the player for {longestBlindS} s in {zone} and {enemiesBlinded} enemies.
opening_duel.won: Won the opening duel against {opponentName} in {zone} with the {weapon}.
opening_duel.lost: Lost the opening duel to {opponentName} in {zone}.
economy_mismatch.saved_on_buy: Went into round {round} with {equipValue} of equipment and {balance} unspent while the team median was {teamMedianEquip}.
economy_mismatch.forced_on_save: Bought {equipValue} of equipment in round {round} while the team median was {teamMedianEquip}.
late_rotation: Reached {site} {arrivalS} s after the plant, {delayS} s behind the team median of {teamMedianArrivalS} s.
late_rotation.never: Did not reach {site} after the plant; teammates arrived after a median of {teamMedianArrivalS} s.
good_plays.trade_kill: Traded {tradedName} by killing {victimName} {tradeTimeS} s later in {zone}.
good_plays.entry_kill: Opened the round by killing {victimName} in {zone} with the {weapon}.
good_plays.multi_kill: Got {kills} kills in {spanS} s, the last in {zone}.
good_plays.clutch: Won the round as the last player alive against {enemiesAlive} enemies, with {killsInClutch} kills.
good_plays.utility_damage: Dealt {utilityDamage} grenade and fire damage to {enemiesHit} enemies.
